title: NxScoreboard
description: A customizable per-world scoreboard plugin with PlaceholderAPI support, stylish config.yml options, and smooth performance for Minecraft servers.
body:
## 📌 NxScoreboard

**NxScoreboard** is a lightweight yet powerful scoreboard plugin for Minecraft servers.
It supports **per-world scoreboards**, full **PlaceholderAPI integration**, and an easy-to-edit `config.yml` so you can fully customize the look of your scoreboard.

---

### ✨ Features

* 🎯 **Per-World Scoreboards** – different scoreboards for Overworld, Nether, End, or any custom world.
* 🔗 **PlaceholderAPI Support** – use placeholders like `%player_name%`, `%vault_eco_balance%`, `%statistic_player_kills%`, `%tps%`, and more.
* ⚡ **Optimized Performance** – efficient scoreboard updates with no lag.
* 🎨 **Customizable Design** – edit titles, lines, and colors in `config.yml`.
* 🛠️ **Admin Command** – `/nxsb reload` to reload the config without restarting the server.

---

### 📝 Commands

* `/nxsb reload` → Reloads the config.

### 🔑 Permissions

* `nxscoreboard.admin` → Allows using `/nxsb reload`.

---

### ⚙️ Example `config.yml`

```yaml
scoreboards:
  default:
    title: "&d&lNxScoreboard"
    lines:
      - '&d&l▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬'
      - '&5&l%player_name%'
      - '&7┃ &2✎ &fʀᴀɴᴋ: &#ffff00%luckperms_prefix%'
      - '&f┃ &#00bbff:watch: &fᴘʟᴀʏᴛɪᴍᴇ: &#00bbff%statistic_time_played:hours%'
      - '&f┃ &a:heavy_dollar_sign: &fᴍᴏɴᴇʏ: &a$%vault_eco_balance%'
      - '&#ad00ffɪɴꜰᴏ:'
      - '&f┃ &6:dagger: &fᴋɪʟʟ: &6%statistic_player_kills%'
      - '&7┃ &3:skull: &fᴅᴇᴀᴛʜѕ: &3%statistic_deaths%'
      - '&#ed00ffѕᴇʀᴠᴇʀ:'
      - '&f┃ &4☀ &fᴛᴘѕ &4%tps%'
      - '&7┃ &b☄ &fᴏɴʟɪɴᴇ: &b%server_online%'
      - '&d&l▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬'

  world_nether:
    title: "&c&lNetherBoard"
    lines:
      - "&cWelcome to Nether!"
      - "&7Player: %player_name%"
      - "&7Balance: $%vault_eco_balance%"
```

---

### 🚀 Compatibility

* **Minecraft Versions:** 1.16 – 1.21+
* **Dependencies:** [PlaceholderAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi) (required), Vault (optional for economy).
